summary: V1 review completed. All 55 tests pass: 24 in test_spine.py, 31 in test_schema_toucher.py. Six checklist items verified: registered schema selector, post-append behavior, draft preservation, whole-spine browsing, readability/integrity, close/move/reopen.
decision_or_outcome: No defect fixes required. One gap noted: dirty flag is scaffolded but never set True; close/schema-switch/spine-switch silently discard unappended field data. Decision: park for V1 (low risk for quick-append workflow). V1 accepted.
open_questions: Should a 'Clear Form' button or dirty guard be added in V2? Should malformed-line skips be surfaced in the Browse UI (e.g., a status count)?
